videos.script: Lesson one closed ports by removing what listened. This lesson closes them a second way. {{filter}} A firewall on the portal itself, with one rule at the bottom: drop. Every other rule is a permission. {{test}} Then you test it from the other side. A dropped port makes the client wait. A rejected one answers at once. {{persist}} You make the rules survive a reboot, and prove it with a restart. {{usb}} Then the other port on every workstation: the USB socket. Data goes out through it, malware comes in, and some devices lie about what they are. {{lab}} The lab cannot plug a device in, and this lesson says exactly where it stops.
